_notes: The papal record as documents (E1 §4.1). Dates are the day a document takes effect in the parishes (Summorum Pontificum 14 September 2007; Mitis Iudex 8 December 2015; Vos estis 1 June 2019; Praedicate Evangelium 5 June 2022; Laudato si' published 18 June 2015; the Missal of 1970 from Advent 1969). A document with an axis moves a policy (axes.json); the rest are read in the Record. Dates and gists flagged for verification (CLAUDE.md rule 12). The record stops with the last pope no longer living.
